'''2011 German National Championship Ralf Wachowiak LS Anger, Fear, Aggression (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Ralf Wachowiak]] at [[2011 German National Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Anger, Fear, Aggression (V) (Virtual Block 4)|VB4-L-angerfearaggression-pre.gif|label=Anger, Fear, Aggression (V)}}
* '''Deck name:''' Macho Madness
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
